# Inspect the 1:1 launch cut

> Validate the square cut's duration, frame rate, dimensions, timed hero, price and CTA, and text containment.

## Step 1 @verifies ac-1, ac-2, ac-5, ac-6, ac-7, ac-8

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=1x1 in the browser, wait for the contact sheet header to read ready, and inspect the composition header for this square cut, then assert its dimensions are 1080x1080 pixels, its frame rate is 30 fps, its duration is 12 seconds, and its declared shots run 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:07, and 0:07–0:12.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-9, ac-10, ac-11, ac-12

In the 1:1 contact sheet's shot 1 frames and facts table, inspect the product hero and caption through 0:01, then assert a teal shoe with orange sole slides in from the left over a dark night-city background, the shoe is fully inside the frame at 0:01, and the exact caption 'Run the city' is fully visible at 0:01.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-13, ac-15, ac-16, ac-17, ac-18

In the 1:1 shot 2 frames and named-layer facts at 0:04, 0:05 and 0:06, inspect the sole, KESTREL wordmark and price tag, then assert the orange sole close-up retains shot 1's teal-and-orange colourway, KESTREL is fully visible at 0:05, and the exact price '€149' is visible at both 0:04 and 0:06.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-19, ac-20, ac-21, ac-22

In the 1:1 shot 3 frames and named-layer facts through 0:09 and the displayed remainder of shot 3, inspect the release headline, early-access button and KESTREL wordmark, then assert the headline reads exactly 'Out 28 November', the button reads exactly 'Get early access' and is fully visible by 0:09, and the wordmark is visible in every displayed shot 3 frame.

## Step 5 @verifies ac-25

Across the 1:1 contact sheet's displayed frames, inspect every rendered text layer and its fully-inside-frame fact, then assert all displayed text layers are fully inside the 1:1 frame.

# Keep vertical text and button clear of reserved bands

> Across the 9:16 contact sheet check text and button do not overlap the top 14% or bottom 35% of the frame.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and wait until the vertical contact sheet header reads ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-23, ac-24, ac-25

On the 9:16 sheet, enable Show safe zones and compare every displayed frame's text and button placement with the shaded top 14% and bottom 35% bands and the text-layer frame-containment facts, then assert no text or button overlaps either restricted band and every displayed text layer is fully inside the frame.
